title: Saturn Music School
native_title: サターンミュージックスクール
overview:
You're a musician starting today!

Using the Sega Saturn and a commercially available MIDI keyboard, you can practice piano and keyboard and do desktop music! In addition to the lessons, 20 cool songs are included. You play the melody or backing along with the songs. You can even make your own original songs with the sequencer!!

Included songs:
- Sing
- Wakare no Kyoku
- The Sound of Silence
- Blade Runner
- When You Wish Upon a Star
- Christmas Eve
- Shima Uta
- A Cruel Angel's Thesis
- OutRun
- Robinson
- Someday
- Machibuse
- Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence
- Lupin III
- In the Mood
- Without You
- Fly Me to the Moon
- Sir Duke
- What's Going On
- Smoke on the Water

君も今日からミュージシャンだ!

セガサターンと市販のMIDIキーボードを使用して、ピアノ、キーボードの練習やDTMができる!レッスンの他にクールな曲を20曲収録。曲に合わせてメロディーやバッキングをあなたが演奏します。シーケンサーを使ってオリジナルの曲もつくれちゃう!!
